verdict.rationale: Bento documents its own DNS onboarding guide for adding records that 'authenticate your domain and allow Bento to send email on your behalf,' and its docs hub explicitly lists authenticating your sending domain as a core setup step. That establishes guided sending-domain authentication as a first-party capability, but the evidence never names SPF, DKIM or DMARC records, alignment, or an in-app verification check. missing for 10: explicit SPF/DKIM/DMARC record coverage, DMARC alignment guidance, documented in-app DNS verification/status checking, independent or hands-on corroboration.
